invariants.rationale: The String[] args parameter provided to the main method is supplied by the JVM and is typically non-null.
The length of any array in Java is always non-negative.
System.out is a standard stream and expected to be initialized by the JVM.
Assuming Foo.bar returns a non-null value for constant inputs, otherwise println would throw NullPointerException.
Literal comparison; might indicate that string literals are internally deduplicated.
